scripts.text:
[Raffoh]
Laoh~!
Welcome to the Village of Mora.
I can tell you whatever you want to know about the village~!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗奧]
拉奧~！
歡迎來到穆拉村莊。
關於村莊的事，你想了解什麼我都可以告訴你~！

scripts.text:
[Raffoh]
Laoh~!
We have an {0} but we can't make travelers sleep like Raffles...
Get some rest!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗奧]
拉奧~！
我們有{0}，但沒法像拉弗爾斯那樣讓旅行者睡得那麼香...
好好休息吧！

scripts.text:
[Raffoh]
Laoh~!
{0} is where Raffles' houses are...
But keep the noise down because people are asleep~!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗奧]
拉奧~！
{0}是拉弗爾斯們住的地方...
不過請小聲一點，因為大家都在睡覺~！

scripts.text:
[Raffoh]
Laoh~!
If you are looking for souvenirs, you can buy some in this {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗奧]
拉奧~！
如果你想買紀念品，可以去這家{0}看看。

scripts.text:
[Raffoh]
Laoh~!
{0} is where they keep all kinds of packages and groceries.
There are many things that don't belong to the Raffles, so be careful!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗奧]
拉奧~！
{0}裡存放著各種包裹和雜貨。
那裡有很多不屬於拉弗爾斯的東西，所以請小心！

scripts.text:
[Raffoh]
Laoh~! I'm removing them all~!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗奧]
拉奧~！我把它們全都移除了~！

scripts.text:
[Raffoh]
Laoh~!
What kinds of sports are popular in your homeland?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗奧]
拉奧~！你們家鄉流行什麼樣的運動？

scripts.text:
[Raffuh]
Uh...
This, this is the Village of Mora.
Uh... which place do you want to know about?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗烏]
呃...
這...這裡是穆拉村莊。
呃...您想了解哪個地方？

scripts.text:
[Raffuh]
Uh...
Are, are you sleepy?
You can sleep {0} uh!! Put your stuff down uh! And-- and---
scripts.translation:
[拉弗烏]
呃...
您...您困了嗎？
您可以去{0}呃！！把東西放下呃！然後--然後---

scripts.text:
[Raffuh]
Uh...
Why are you trying to find out {0} I live--?
Uh, no... I'd like to live with my friends--
scripts.translation:
[拉弗烏]
呃...
您...您為什麼要打聽{0}我住--？
呃，不...我想和朋友們住在一起--

scripts.text:
[Raffuh]
Uh...
There are a lot of things in those {0}-- oh, there is a hot spring also uh!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗烏]
呃...
那些{0}裡有很多東西--哦，那裡還有溫泉呃！

scripts.text:
[Raffuh]
Uh...
You can't just march into the {0}, or you'll be in trouble--
Many of the things there are from outside the village-- Raffuh has been in trouble several times--
scripts.translation:
[拉弗烏]
呃...
你不能隨便闖進{0}，否則會有麻煩--
那裡有很多來自村莊外面的東西--拉弗烏已經惹過好幾次麻煩了--

scripts.text:
[Raffuh]
Are you sure you want them removed?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗烏]
您確定要移除它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffuh]
Uh...
Being a guide doesn't help much with my social phobia--
scripts.translation:
[拉弗烏]
呃...
當嚮導對我克服社交恐懼症沒什麼幫助--

scripts.text:
[Raffla]
Lala!
Welcome to the Village of Mora la!
If you need to know anything about the village, just ask me la!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗拉]
拉拉！
歡迎來到穆拉村莊啦！
如果您想了解村莊的任何事情，儘管問我啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffla]
Lala!
{0} is where travelers can rest la!
The innkeeper is very kind, so try to talk to him a lot la!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗拉]
拉拉！
{0}是旅行者可以休息的地方啦！
旅店老闆人很好，所以多和他聊聊啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffla]
Lala!
{0} is where Raffles live la!
Head over there la!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗拉]
拉拉！
{0}是拉弗爾斯居住的地方啦！
快去那邊看看啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffla]
Lala!
So you want to buy something la?
There are a lot of {0}, so check them out la!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗拉]
拉拉！
你想買東西嗎啦？
那裡有很多{0}，快去看看吧啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffla]
Lala!
The {0} is where you keep your valuables la!
Be careful so you don't get robbed la!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗拉]
拉拉！
{0}是存放貴重物品的地方啦！
小心別被偷啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffla]
Okay, I'll remove all the markers from the map la!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗拉]
好的，我會移除地圖上所有的標記啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffla]
Lala!
I really don't know how my family ends up doing these things la!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗拉]
拉拉！
我真的不知道我家為什麼總是做這種事啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffli]
Lali?
{0} is where Raffles live.
Are you coming to Raffli's house li? I'm so happy.

[拉弗利]
拉拉？
{0}是拉弗爾斯居住的地方。
你是來拉弗利家的嗎？我好開心。

scripts.text:
[Raffli]
Lali?
There are a lot of things I want to buy.
You can find tons of {0} to eat and shop, and tons of things to buy.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗利]
拉拉？
有很多我想買的東西。
那裡有很多{0}可以吃喝購物，還有很多東西可以買。

scripts.text:

Lali?
The {0} is where you keep your valuables.
But don't get robbed.

拉拉？
{0}是存放貴重物品的地方。
但是別被偷了。

I'll remove all the markers.

[拉弗利]
我會移除所有的標記。

scripts.text:
[Raffli]
Lali?
Brother seems to be upset today li. Did I do anything wrong?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗利]
拉拉？
哥哥今天好像心情不好。是我做錯什麼了嗎？
